RoutineTask.title: RoutineTask
RoutineTask.description: Represents a scheduled activity for a patient with Alzheimer's, including the time and the audio track to play.

id.description: Unique identifier for the routine task.

title.description: Name of the activity (e.g., 'Take medication', 'Lunch time').

time.description: Time of day in HH:mm format (24h).

trackNumber.description: The specific track number on the SD card (1-9).

isActive.description: Whether this reminder is currently enabled.

lastCompletedAt.description: The last time the patient pressed the button for this specific task.

DeviceSettings.title: DeviceSettings
DeviceSettings.description: Operational parameters for the physical SafeDay device.

volume.description: Volume level for the DFPlayer Mini (0-30).

definition.description: Stores individual tasks for a patient's daily routine.
